reason: I already pay for a charter package that does bookings, quotes and allocation, and it has years of my customers and jobs in it. I don't have time to learn new software or move all that across just to have the same things under a new name.
objection: It's a brand new company with no customers. If it falls over or they go broke halfway through school excursion season, my bookings are stuck in their system and I'm the one ringing schools to apologise.
would_change_my_mind: Them moving all my existing data across for me at no cost, with a couple of operators I know from the bus association meetings already running on it for a year without dramas.
